title: tinyBenchmarks: evaluating LLMs with fewer examples
reasoning: The paper focuses on efficient benchmarking of LLMs through statistical methods like Item Response Theory. While MMLU (one of the benchmarks used) includes subjects like "philosophy" and "moral dilemmas" as academic categories, the paper does not specifically evaluate or benchmark LLMs on their "faith, ethics, or moral reasoning" as a primary or explicit component beyond general knowledge assessment. The Impact Statement is a general disclaimer, not an evaluative component.
